title: Language as Trait, Politeness as Strategy: Controlled Tests of Linguistic Effects in LLM Social-Deduction Agents
title_zh: 语言即特质，礼貌即策略：LLM社交推理智能体中语言效应的受控测试

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate through conversation, and the same message can be phrased in simpler or more complex language, bluntly or politely. We test whether such differences change how other agents judge and act, using the LURK Werewolf framework, which separates each utterance’s speech-act predicate from its natural-language realization. We rewrite only the realization, check that the game content is preserved, and replay each game day from saved checkpoints against a re-sampled control. We vary linguistic range consistently across a speaker’s messages and politeness strategy per utterance. Across 30 games and 4,335 replays, neither manipulation changes the trust other agents place in the speaker, and no effect on votes or night actions survives correction for multiple comparisons; the largest uncorrected effect is that shifting range away from a neutral paraphrase changes about 4 percentage points more of the other players’ votes. In natural play, 88% of face-threatening speech is bald on-record regardless of role.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过对话进行协调，同一条消息可以用更简单或更复杂的语言来表述，也可以用直率或礼貌的方式来表达。 我们测试这类差异是否会改变其他智能体的判断与行动，所使用的是 LURK Werewolf 框架，该框架将每条话语的言语行为谓词与其自然语言实现分离开来。 我们只改写其实现方式，核实游戏内容保持不变，并在重新采样的对照组下从保存的检查点重放每个游戏日。 我们在每个说话者的所有消息上保持语言风格范围的一致变化，并逐条话语地改变礼貌策略。 在 30 局游戏和 4,335 次重放中，两种操纵都没有改变其他智能体对说话者所给予的信任，且对投票或夜间行动没有任何效应能在多重比较校正后存活；未校正的最大效应是，将风格范围从中性改述移开会改变其他玩家约 4 个百分点的投票。 在自然对局中，无论角色如何，88% 的威胁面子的言语都是直陈式的。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents use natural-language conversations to coordinate tasks and collaborate on problem solving ( Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) . In these interactions, messages convey not only task-related information but also the manner in which the speaker presents it. The same claim can be expressed in simpler or more complex language, stated directly, or softened through hedging and polite phrasing. Even when the message is unchanged, these differences may affect how other agents behave.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体使用自然语言对话来协调任务并协作解决问题 ( Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 )。 在这些交互中，消息不仅传递与任务相关的信息，还传递说话者呈现信息的方式。 同一主张可以用更简单或更复杂的语言表达，可以直接陈述，也可以通过模糊限定词和礼貌措辞加以软化。 即使消息内容不变，这些差异也可能影响其他智能体的行为方式。

paragraphs.en: Previous research shows that linguistic form can affect LLM responses and evaluations. Models exhibit biases in their responses to different English dialects ( Fleisig et al., 2024 ) . Some models are more likely to accept false claims expressed in a formal, sophisticated register ( Maraia et al., 2026 ) . LLM judges can also assign higher scores to incorrect mathematical solutions when persuasive appeals are added ( Hwang et al., 2025 ) . However, these studies leave open how linguistic differences affect decisions in ongoing multi-agent interactions, where agents must evaluate competing claims and act on their judgments. Moreover, natural differences in wording often coincide with differences in content and conversational context, making it difficult to isolate the effect of language itself.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究表明，语言形式会影响大语言模型的回复与评估。 模型在回应不同英语方言时会表现出偏见 ( Fleisig et al., 2024 ) 。 一些模型更容易接受以正式、精致语体表达的错误论断 ( Maraia et al., 2026 ) 。 当加入说服性诉求时，大语言模型评判者也会给错误的数学解答打更高分 ( Hwang et al., 2025 ) 。 然而，这些研究尚未回答语言差异如何影响进行中的多智能体交互中的决策，在这类交互中，智能体必须评估相互竞争的主张并依据其判断采取行动。 此外，措辞上的自然差异往往与内容和会话语境的差异同时出现，这使得很难分离出语言本身的影响。

paragraphs.en: We examine two dimensions of linguistic variation. Linguistic range refers to differences in the vocabulary and sentence structures used to express a message, which we vary consistently across a speaker’s messages. Politeness strategies refer to how particular speech acts are expressed, including directness, solidarity, deference, and indirectness ( Brown and Levinson, 1987 ) . Unlike the speaker-level linguistic-range manipulation, politeness can vary from one utterance to the next depending on the context. We study both in the LURK Werewolf framework ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , which separates each speech act’s content from its natural-language realization, so that we can rewrite only the realization and replay the game from matched checkpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考察语言变异的两个维度。 语言范围指用于表达信息的词汇和句子结构上的差异，我们在同一位说话者的各条消息之间保持一致地变化这些差异。 礼貌策略指特定言语行为如何被表达，包括直接、团结、尊敬和间接（Brown and Levinson, 1987）。 与说话者层面的语言范围操控不同，礼貌可以随语境从一句话到下一句话发生变化。 我们在 LURK Werewolf 框架（Liu et al., 2026）中对两者进行研究，该框架将每个言语行为的内容与其自然语言实现分离开来，从而我们可以只重写实现部分，并从匹配的检查点重放游戏。

paragraphs.en: Lexical and syntactic features have been widely used to assess language proficiency. Lexical measures such as word frequency, lexical diversity, and word familiarity have been used to predict proficiency in second language writing ( Crossley and McNamara, 2012 ) . Measures of lexical sophistication have also explained variation in human ratings of vocabulary use and speaking proficiency ( Kyle and Crossley, 2015 ) . Computational models have used linguistic features to classify CEFR proficiency levels across different languages Vajjala and Rama (2018) . Analyzing how linguistic complexity varies throughout a text has also improved CEFR classification compared with using summary measures ( Kerz et al., 2021 ) . Syntactic features associated with language development can differ from those that predict human evaluations of writing quality ( Crossley and McNamara, 2014 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 词汇和句法特征已被广泛用于评估语言水平。 词频、词汇多样性和词汇熟悉度等词汇指标已被用于预测二语写作的水平（Crossley and McNamara, 2012）。 词汇复杂度指标也能解释人类对词汇使用和口语水平评分中的差异（Kyle and Crossley, 2015）。 计算模型已利用语言特征对不同语言的 CEFR 水平等级进行分类（Vajjala and Rama, 2018）。 与使用汇总指标相比，分析语言复杂性在文本中的变化也提升了 CEFR 分类效果（Kerz et al., 2021）。 与语言发展相关的句法特征可能不同于那些能预测人类对写作质量评价的句法特征（Crossley and McNamara, 2014）。

paragraphs.en: Linguistic style can influence how people evaluate speakers and their messages. Readers have rated authors using bureaucratic writing as more knowledgeable than those using plain language, but not more trustworthy ( Chartprasert, 1993 ) . Technical language in online health information has also been found to reduce perceived author integrity and information credibility ( Thon and Jucks, 2017 ) . Even semantically equivalent expressions can receive different evaluations, as rhyming aphorisms have been judged more accurate than non-rhyming versions ( McGlone and Tofighbakhsh, 2000 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 语言风格会影响人们如何评价说话者及其传递的信息。 有研究发现，读者认为使用官僚式写作的作者比使用平实语言的作者更有学识，但并不更值得信赖（Chartprasert, 1993）。 在线健康信息中的技术性语言也被发现会降低感知到的作者诚信和信息可信度（Thon and Jucks, 2017）。 即使语义等价的表达也可能获得不同的评价，例如押韵的格言被认为比不押韵的版本更准确（McGlone and Tofighbakhsh, 2000）。

paragraphs.en: Brown and Levinson’s politeness theory ( Brown and Levinson, 1987 ) explains how people use language to minimize social friction and manage “face,” which is a person’s public self-image. Social interactions often involve face-threatening acts like requests or criticisms, prompting speakers to choose from strategies ranging from direct (“bald on-record”), affirming the listener (“positive politeness”), minimizing imposition (“negative politeness”), and indirect (“off-record”) statements. The theory states that the strategy chosen depends heavily on the power dynamic, social distance, and size of the request between the speakers.
paragraphs.zh: Brown 和 Levinson 的礼貌理论（Brown and Levinson, 1987）解释了人们如何通过语言来减少社会摩擦并管理「面子」，即一个人的公开自我形象。 社会互动中常常涉及请求或批评等威胁面子行为，这促使说话者从多种策略中进行选择：直接的（「赤裸裸公开策略」）、肯定听话者的（「积极礼貌策略」）、尽量减少强加的（「消极礼貌策略」）以及间接的（「非公开策略」）表达。 该理论指出，所选策略在很大程度上取决于说话者之间的权力关系、社会距离以及请求的大小。

paragraphs.en: This study uses the LURK Werewolf framework ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , which uses the multi-agent, incomplete information, social deduction game Werewolf , as an environment to study linguistic bias. In the game, players are assigned hidden roles and attempt to identify and vote out or kill members of the opposing team. Each game consists of seven players, including two werewolves, one seer, one guard, and three villagers. The game alternates between day and night phases. During the day, players discuss their suspicions, share information, and vote to eliminate a player. At night, werewolves select a player to attack, while the seer and guard perform their respective actions. Werewolf players know their teammates and coordinate covertly during the day, while village players do not know anyone else’s identity and must deduce the truth through their social interactions during the day. Players make decisions based on their assigned roles, private and public information of the game. After each day, every player rates every other living player on a 1–10 reliability scale.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究使用 LURK Werewolf 框架（Liu et al., 2026），该框架采用多智能体、不完全信息的社会推理游戏「狼人杀」作为环境来研究语言偏见。 在游戏中，玩家被分配隐藏角色，并试图识别并投票淘汰或杀死对方团队的成员。 每局游戏由七名玩家组成，包括两只狼人、一名预言家、一名守卫和三名村民。 游戏在白天和夜晚阶段之间交替进行。 白天，玩家讨论自己的怀疑、分享信息，并投票淘汰一名玩家。 夜晚，狼人选择一名玩家进行攻击，而预言家和守卫则执行各自的行为。 狼人玩家知道自己的队友并在白天进行秘密协调，而村民玩家不知道其他任何人的身份，必须通过白天时的社交互动来推断真相。 玩家根据其被分配的角色以及游戏的私密信息和公开信息做出决策。 每天结束后，每位玩家按照 1–10 的可靠度量表对所有其他存活玩家进行评分。

paragraphs.en: LURK Werewolf represents communication through structured speech-act predicates. Each predicate specifies a communicative action and its arguments, including the speaker, referenced players, and relevant game information. For example, an estimate predicate expresses a belief about another player’s role, while recommend_action represents a recommendation directed toward another player. Each predicate is converted into a natural-language utterance that other players receive during gameplay; the predicate itself stays in the game record and is not shown to other players. The predicate representation records the content and communicative function of the utterance, while its natural-language realization determines how the message is expressed.
paragraphs.zh: LURK 狼人杀通过结构化的言语行为谓词来表示交流。 每个谓词规定了一种交流行为及其参数，包括发言者、被提及的玩家以及相关的游戏信息。 例如，estimate 谓词表达对另一名玩家角色的看法，而 recommend_action 表示针对另一名玩家提出的建议。 每个谓词都会被转换为一句自然语言发言，其他玩家在游戏过程中收到的是这句话；谓词本身保留在游戏记录中，不会展示给其他玩家。 谓词表示记录了发言的内容和交流功能，而其自然语言实现方式则决定了消息如何被表达。

paragraphs.en: Counterfactual replays are used to measure how linguistic variation affects agents’ decisions. Thirty baseline games are played once, and checkpoints are saved at the beginning of each day. Each checkpoint contains the game state and public interaction history required to resume gameplay.
paragraphs.zh: 反事实重放用于测量语言变化如何影响智能体的决策。 三十个基线游戏各进行一次，并在每天开始时保存检查点。 每个检查点包含恢复游戏所需的游戏状态和公开交互历史。

paragraphs.en: Each checkpoint is replayed under different linguistic conditions in the flip_self setting, in which one designated speaker receives the language manipulation throughout the replayed day (discussion, vote, night, and the reliability update); each living player serves as the designated speaker in turn. The game-playing agents use deepseek-chat , a non-deterministic model, which can return different responses to the same prompt even at temperature 0. A control replay without any rewriting is therefore run at each checkpoint to measure this variation, and rewritten replays are compared against it. The control is run twice per player-day; the linguistic-range levels are run once each and the politeness settings twice each.
paragraphs.zh: 在 flip_self 设置下，每个检查点在不同的语言条件下被重放，其中一名指定的发言者在整个重放的一天中（讨论、投票、夜晚以及可靠性更新）接受语言操纵；每个存活玩家依次轮流担任指定发言者。 该游戏智能体使用 deepseek-chat（一个非确定性模型），即使温度为 0，它对同一提示也可能返回不同的响应。 因此，在每个检查点都会运行一次不含任何改写的对照重放，以衡量这种变化，并将改写后的重放与其进行比较。 对照在每个玩家日运行两次；语言幅度等级各运行一次，礼貌设置各运行两次。

paragraphs.en: Each rewrite is checked before it enters the game. The judge model then answers two yes/no questions: whether the action toward the same target is unchanged, and whether the original’s reasons are still given. A rewrite that fails is regenerated once at temperature 0.7; if it fails again, the speaker’s original text is delivered and the fallback is logged.

paragraphs.en: Language proficiency is multidimensional. The CEFR distinguishes linguistic range from grammatical control, with range describing the repertoire of linguistic forms available to a speaker ( Council of Europe, 2020 ) . Following computational proficiency assessment ( Vajjala and Rama, 2018 ; Kerz et al., 2021 ) , Experiment 1 manipulates lexical and syntactic range in three relative conditions. Low uses more frequent and repetitive vocabulary with a narrower syntactic repertoire. Neutral paraphrases the untreated ( Natural ) utterance at a similar range. High uses more varied vocabulary and a broader syntactic repertoire.

paragraphs.en: The rewriter is validated in a pilot that uses Qwen3.5-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as the rewriter and a stricter gate than the in-game one: structural checks, an inverse parser that must recover the predicate from the rewrite alone, and a fidelity judge, with up to two corrective retries. On 315 constructed rewrites that either break a target, role, polarity, reason, certainty, or directive force or preserve them, this gate has a sensitivity of 0.996 and a specificity of 0.978. For Neutral, five candidate paraphrases are generated and the candidate closest to Natural in lexical and structural properties is selected.

paragraphs.en: Validation uses matched 150–250 word speaker passages constructed from the same source utterances, drawn from three untreated nine-player games (280 public utterances, 24 passages). Lexical range is measured using SUBTLEX-US frequency, MATTR, MTLD, and repetition ( Crossley and McNamara, 2012 ; Kyle and Crossley, 2015 ) , and syntactic range using clause, dependency, and phrasal complexity measures ( Bulté and Housen, 2012 ; Lu, 2011 ) . LanguageTool and CoLA assess grammatical quality across conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 验证使用由相同源话语构建的150–250词的匹配说话者段落，这些段落取自三场未处理的九玩家游戏（280条公开话语，24个段落）。 词汇多样性使用SUBTLEX-US频率、MATTR、MTLD和重复度进行测量（Crossley and McNamara, 2012; Kyle and Crossley, 2015），句法多样性则使用从句、依存和短语复杂度指标进行测量（Bulté and Housen, 2012; Lu, 2011）。 LanguageTool和CoLA用于评估各条件下的语法质量。

paragraphs.en: Against Neutral (15 passages), Low uses more frequent words (SUBTLEX-US + 0.26 +0.26 ), lower lexical diversity (MATTR − 0.015 -0.015 ), and fewer subordinate clauses ( − 1.0 -1.0 per 100 words), all with game-clustered intervals excluding zero; MTLD, repetition, dependency distance, and tree depth agree. High uses rarer and more varied vocabulary than Neutral (SUBTLEX-US − 0.50 -0.50 , MATTR + 0.019 +0.019 ), while its syntactic measures stay within noise. Neutral stays close to Natural (SUBTLEX-US − 0.03 -0.03 [ − 0.06 -0.06 , + 0.02 +0.02 ], MATTR − 0.002 -0.002 ). Low does not degrade grammar: it has 0.02 more LanguageTool errors per 100 words than Neutral (one-sided upper bound 0.04).

paragraphs.en: As an additional manipulation check, the politeness judge was applied to 200 randomly sampled rewrites and their Natural counterparts. The distribution of politeness strategies was similar across the two sets, with 80% classified as bald on-record in both.

paragraphs.en: GPT Luna 5.6, Qwen3.5-27B, and two human researchers evaluate the same matched passage pairs. For each pair, the listener selects which passage appears to use a more limited range of English or selects no meaningful difference . The comparisons are Low versus Neutral, Neutral versus High, Low versus High, and Neutral versus Natural; the researchers annotate independently.
paragraphs.zh: GPT Luna 5.6、Qwen3.5-27B 和两名人类研究者对相同的配对段落进行评估。 对于每一对段落，听者选择哪一段看起来使用了更有限的英语范围，或选择无实质差异。 比较组合为低与中性、中性与高、低与高、中性与自然；两位研究者独立进行标注。

sents.zh: 对于每一对段落，听者选择哪一段看起来使用了更有限的英语范围，或选择无实质差异。

paragraphs.en: Both LLM listeners judge Low more limited than Neutral and High, and High less limited than Neutral, in every passage and both presentation orders. On Neutral versus Natural, Qwen answers “same” in 97% of pairs and GPT Luna in 63%. Both researchers choose the expected relation in 82% of pairs ( Table 1 ), including every Low–High and Neutral–High pair; all 11 disagreements fall on the subtle contrasts (Low–Neutral, Neutral–Natural), where one researcher saw a difference and the other did not. A third annotator, blind to condition, adjudicated these 11 pairs; the consensus labels match the expected relation in 57 of 62 pairs (92%).
paragraphs.zh: 两个大语言模型监听者在所有篇章和两种呈现顺序下都判定 Low 比 Neutral 和 High 更受限，High 比 Neutral 更不受限。 在 Neutral 与 Natural 的对比上，Qwen 在 97% 的配对中回答“相同”，GPT Luna 为 63%。 两位研究者在 82% 的配对中选择了预期关系（表 1），包括所有 Low–High 和 Neutral–High 配对；全部 11 处不一致都出现在细微对比上（Low–Neutral、Neutral–Natural），即一位研究者看到了差异而另一位没有。 一位不知晓实验条件的第三位标注者对这 11 对进行了裁定；一致标签在 62 对中的 57 对（92%）符合预期关系。

paragraphs.en: The 30 seven-player baseline games yield 289 focal-player and day combinations, each replayed once under Low, Neutral, and High and twice under Natural (1,445 replays).
paragraphs.zh: 这30场七名玩家的基线对局产生了289个“焦点玩家-天数”组合，每个组合在低、中、高条件下各重放一次，在自然条件下重放两次（共1,445次重放）。

paragraphs.en: The original wording was delivered after two failed attempts for only 1.2% (Low), 0.7% (Neutral), and 1.0% (High) of the 3,615 rewrites.
paragraphs.zh: 在3,615次重写中，仅有1.2%（低）、0.7%（中）和1.0%（高）的情况下，原始措辞是在两次失败尝试之后才给出的。

paragraphs.en: The primary comparison is Low versus Neutral. We compare each replayed day with the baseline day and measure the share of other players’ votes and of night-skill targets that differ from the baseline ( vote and skill change), and the mean absolute change in reliability scores ( trust ). High versus Neutral examines the effect of expanded linguistic range, while Neutral versus Natural measures the effect of paraphrasing.
paragraphs.zh: 主要比较是 Low 与 Neutral 的对比。 我们将每个重放的回合与基线回合进行比较，测量其他玩家投票和夜间技能目标与基线不同的比例（vote 和 skill change），以及可靠性分数的平均绝对变化（trust）。 High 与 Neutral 的对比考察扩展语言范围的影响，而 Neutral 与 Natural 的对比则测量改写的影响。

Games are the independent unit: 95% intervals resample whole games (2,000 draws), and p p -values come from a sign-flip test that flips each game’s differences together. We correct with Holm across all contrasts and measures in a table (15 tests here, 12 for politeness).

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports the language levels. Paraphrasing at the original range (Neutral) leaves decisions where the control leaves them: skill and vote changes fall slightly below the control, and both intervals include zero. Changing the range moves them in uncorrected tests: relative to Neutral, High raises vote changes by 3.9 pp [+1.2, +6.5] ( p = .009 p=.009 ) and skill changes by 3.4 pp [+0.6, +6.6] ( p = .030 p=.030 ), and Low raises vote changes by 4.2 pp [+1.3, +7.3] ( p = .020 p=.020 ). Relative to the control, Low and High raise vote changes by about 2 pp, with intervals including zero, so part of the contrast reflects Neutral lying slightly below the control. Reliability scores do not move at any level. No difference survives Holm correction across the 15 tests (smallest adjusted p = .13 p=.13 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表2报告了语言水平的结果。 在原始区间进行改写（中性，Neutral）时，决策结果与对照组相当：技能和投票变化的数值略低于对照组，且两个区间都包含零。 改变区间会使未经校正的检验结果发生变化：相对于中性水平，高水平使投票变化提高3.9个百分点 [+1.2, +6.5]（p = .009），技能变化提高3.4个百分点 [+0.6, +6.6]（p = .030）；低水平使投票变化提高4.2个百分点 [+1.3, +7.3]（p = .020）。 相对于对照组，低水平和高水平使投票变化提高约2个百分点，区间包含零，因此部分差异反映了中性水平略低于对照组。 可靠性得分在任何水平上都没有变化。 在15项检验中，没有任何差异在Holm校正后仍然显著（最小校正后p = .13）。

paragraphs.en: The politeness rewriter replaces a predicate’s realization with one that expresses a given strategy while preserving its strategic content.

paragraphs.en: For the politeness validation study and the politeness bias experiment, we restrict attention to the following nine face-threatening speech acts whose expression can be redressed without changing their content: estimate , question , agree , disagree , address_role , allied , unallied , dissociate , recommend_action . paragraphs.en: We validate the politeness judge model by calculating its agreement with the researcher labels and the politeness dataset of Zhao and Hawkins (2025) , with the results in Table 4 . On the 43 items where both researchers agreed, the judge matched their label on 91% of items ( κ = 0.88 \kappa=0.88 ) and matched the strategy the rewriter was asked to produce on 87% (45 of 52), so we use it to label politeness in natural play. On Zhao and Hawkins (2025) , which contains feedback on another person’s performance (e.g., a recital or a presentation), the judge reached 70% accuracy ( κ = 0.59 \kappa=0.59 ), with perfect recall for bald on-record (31 of 31) but very low recall for off-record (1 of 14). We attribute this gap to how their labels were assigned: annotators knew the speaker’s true evaluation, so feedback such as “It was interesting” paired with a private rating of 0 out of 3 is a clear understatement and hence off-record. In our setting, the speaker’s private evaluation is unavailable, so the same remark cannot be confidently read as off-record criticism.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过计算该礼貌判定模型与研究者标注以及 Zhao 和 Hawkins (2025) 礼貌数据集的一致性来对其进行验证，结果见表 4。 在两位研究者意见一致的 43 个条目上，判定模型在 91% 的条目上与他们的标注一致（κ = 0.88 \kappa=0.88），并在 87% 的条目上与要求改写者生成的策略一致（52 条中的 45 条），因此我们使用它对自然游玩中的礼貌进行标注。 在 Zhao 和 Hawkins (2025) 数据集上——该数据集包含对他人表现（如演奏会或演讲）的反馈——判定模型达到 70% 的准确率（κ = 0.59 \kappa=0.59），对直白公开策略的召回率完美（31 条中的 31 条），但对隐含间接策略的召回率极低（14 条中的 1 条）。 我们将这一差距归因于其标注的分配方式：标注者知道说话者的真实评价，因此诸如“挺有意思的”这类反馈若与私下的 0 分（满分 3 分）评分配对，就是一种明显的轻描淡写，因而属于隐含间接。 在我们的场景中，说话者的私下评价不可得，因此同一句评论无法被确定地解读为隐含间接的批评。

paragraphs.en: Politeness strategies are distributed almost identically across roles ( Table 5 ). Bald on-record accounts for 86–89% of utterances for every role. Werewolves, who must conceal their alignment, use slightly more positive politeness (10% against 5–9%), and roles do not differ detectably in how often they leave bald on-record ( p = .73 p=.73 , permuting roles within games). The speech act matters more than the role: 18% of recommend_action utterances are non-bald, mostly positive politeness, against 1% of question utterances. In answer to RQ2A, agents do not appear to adopt role-specific politeness strategies. Their politeness is better described as a shared default register, dominated by direct statements, than as a strategic choice tied to their hidden role. Because the judge has low off-record recall on external data ( Section 5.2 ), off-record frequencies should be read as lower bounds.
paragraphs.zh: 礼貌策略在各角色间的分布几乎完全一致（表 5）。 对于每个角色，直接策略（bald on-record）占其话语的 86–89%。 必须隐藏自己阵营身份的狼人（Werewolves）使用稍多的积极礼貌策略（10% 对 5–9%），而各角色在直接策略使用频率上的差异不可检测（p = .73 p=.73 ，在游戏内对角色进行置换检验）。 言语行为比角色更重要：recommend_action 类话语中有 18% 是非直接策略，且多为积极礼貌策略，而 question 类话语中仅占 1%。 对于 RQ2A 的回答是：智能体似乎并未采用与角色相关的礼貌策略。 智能体的礼貌更适合被描述为一种由直接陈述主导的共享默认语域，而非与其隐藏角色绑定的策略性选择。 由于裁判模型在外部数据上的 off-record 召回率较低（第 5.2 节），off-record 的频率应被视为下限。

paragraphs.en: For village players, the uninformed majority, reliability scores are trust scores they track and update from the speeches and facts presented during the game. We use the speaker’s score for the listener in force when the utterance is made (537 utterances from village-side speakers). Non-bald speech rises with trust, almost entirely through positive politeness: 5% toward listeners rated 1–3, 11% at 4–7, and 33% at 8–10. Holding speaker, game, and speech act fixed, the association is borderline ( p = .057 p=.057 ), and only 12 utterances go to highly trusted listeners, so this pattern is suggestive. For wolves, reliability scores instead record confidence in role guesses (always 10 for a teammate), and show no association with strategy ( p = .39 p=.39 ). Non-bald labels have not been checked by hand, and 81 of the 178 are split decisions across judge passes.
paragraphs.zh: 对于作为无信息多数方的村民玩家而言，可靠性分数就是他们在游戏中根据发言和事实进行跟踪和更新的信任分数。 我们使用话语发出时对听者生效的说话者分数（来自村民阵营说话者的 537 条话语）。 非直陈性言语随信任度上升，几乎完全通过积极礼貌体现：对评级为 1–3 的听者为 5%，4–7 为 11%，8–10 为 33%。 在固定说话者、游戏和言语行为的情况下，该关联处于临界水平（p = .057），且仅有 12 条话语面向高信任度听者，因此这一模式仅具提示性。 对于狼人而言，可靠性分数记录的是对角色猜测的置信度（对队友始终为 10），并与策略无关联（p = .39）。 非直陈性标签未经人工核查，178 条中有 81 条在不同评判轮次中存在分歧。

paragraphs.en: Section 5.3 suggested that village agents use more positive politeness toward listeners they trust, and that bald on-record and positive politeness are the most common strategies. We exclude off-record, whose rewrites soften the key statement until the meaning is mostly lost (8% meaning kept; Table 3 ), turning “[player] looks like a wolf protecting the partner who vouched for him” into “I’ll leave it to everyone else to decide what that pattern usually means.” We also exclude negative politeness, which redresses mainly through hedging and would confound strategy with commitment strength. We apply each of four mixed strategies to all rewriteable utterances of the designated speaker: 1. all bald on-record ( all_bald ); 2. all positive politeness ( all_positive ); 3. bald on-record to trusted listeners, positive politeness to distrusted listeners ( trust_bald ); 4. positive politeness to trusted listeners, bald on-record to distrusted listeners ( trust_positive ). A speaker counts a listener as trusted if the listener is in the top half of the speaker’s own current reliability ranking. The fourth setting follows the natural pattern and enforces it more strictly, while the third setting inverts the natural pattern. If agents view politeness as a relational signal rather than as surface linguistic style, the congruent and incongruent settings should differ from each other and from the uniform ones.
paragraphs.zh: 第5.3节表明，村庄智能体对其信任的听者会使用更多积极礼貌策略，而直言不讳和积极礼貌是最常见的策略。 我们排除间接策略（off-record），因为其改写会软化关键陈述直至含义大多丢失（仅保留8%的含义；见表3），把「[玩家]看起来像一头在保护那个为他担保的同伙的狼」改写成「我会留给大家来决定这种模式通常意味着什么」。我们还排除消极礼貌，它主要通过模糊限定语来补救，会将策略与承诺强度混淆。 我们将四种混合策略分别应用于指定说话者的所有可改发言：1. 全部直言不讳（all_bald）；2. 全部积极礼貌（all_positive）；3. 对信任的听者使用直言不讳，对不信任的听者使用积极礼貌（trust_bald）；4. 对信任的听者使用积极礼貌，对不信任的听者使用直言不讳（trust_positive）。 如果某听者位于说话者自己当前可靠性排名的前一半，说话者即将其视为可信。 第四种设置遵循自然模式并更严格地强制执行，而第三种设置则逆转了自然模式。 如果智能体将礼貌视为关系信号而非表层语言风格，那么一致与不一致设置应彼此不同，且与统一设置不同。

sents.zh: 我们排除间接策略（off-record），因为其改写会软化关键陈述直至含义大多丢失（仅保留8%的含义；见表3），把「[玩家]看起来像一头在保护那个为他担保的同伙的狼」改写成「我会留给大家来决定这种模式通常意味着什么」。我们还排除消极礼貌，它主要通过模糊限定语来补救，会将策略与承诺强度混淆。

sents.en: We apply each of four mixed strategies to all rewriteable utterances of the designated speaker: 1. all bald on-record ( all_bald ); 2. all positive politeness ( all_positive ); 3. bald on-record to trusted listeners, positive politeness to distrusted listeners ( trust_bald ); 4. positive politeness to trusted listeners, bald on-record to distrusted listeners ( trust_positive ).
sents.zh: 我们将四种混合策略分别应用于指定说话者的所有可改发言：1. 全部直言不讳（all_bald）；2. 全部积极礼貌（all_positive）；3. 对信任的听者使用直言不讳，对不信任的听者使用积极礼貌（trust_bald）；4. 对信任的听者使用积极礼貌，对不信任的听者使用直言不讳（trust_positive）。

sents.en: A speaker counts a listener as trusted if the listener is in the top half of the speaker’s own current reliability ranking.
sents.zh: 如果某听者位于说话者自己当前可靠性排名的前一半，说话者即将其视为可信。

sents.en: The fourth setting follows the natural pattern and enforces it more strictly, while the third setting inverts the natural pattern.
sents.zh: 第四种设置遵循自然模式并更严格地强制执行，而第三种设置则逆转了自然模式。

sents.en: If agents view politeness as a relational signal rather than as surface linguistic style, the congruent and incongruent settings should differ from each other and from the uniform ones.
sents.zh: 如果智能体将礼貌视为关系信号而非表层语言风格，那么一致与不一致设置应彼此不同，且与统一设置不同。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 reports each setting relative to the control over 30 seeds (289 player-days, 2,890 replays). Of 7,785 treated utterances, the original wording was delivered when both attempts failed for 11.0% under all_bald , 1.3% under all_positive , 6.0% under trust_positive , and 7.2% under trust_bald ; bald rewrites fail mostly because a justification was trimmed, and fallbacks dilute a setting toward the control. Rewriting the self player’s speech has at most a small effect on the decisions that follow. Night skill targets change 1.4 to 2.3 pp more often than in the control, against a control drift of 9.9%, and only all_bald ’s interval excludes zero (+2.3 [+0.4, +4.0]). Vote targets show no effect: every interval includes zero. Reliability scores move by 0.62 points on average under the control, and no setting adds more than 0.01 points to that. Politeness strategy makes no consistent difference: positive and bald rewrites produce effects of similar size on all three measures, whether the strategy is applied uniformly or matched to the speaker’s trust in the listener. In an exploratory directional analysis, all_positive lowers the reliability that village agents assign to the speaker by 0.08 points ([ − - 0.14, − - 0.02], uncorrected p = .012 p=.012 ).

paragraphs.en: The range manipulation is clearly perceptible: both LLM listeners and both researchers recover the Low–High ordering in every pair. Yet agents do not trust a speaker with restricted range less, and no effect on votes or night actions survives correction. The trust estimates are bounded by narrow intervals (within ± \pm 0.03 points on a 10-point scale), so they indicate the absence of a practically relevant trust penalty rather than merely a lack of power. The uncorrected pattern on votes, where departing from a neutral paraphrase in either direction changes more votes, is consistent with agents reacting to a change in style as such rather than to restricted range; it warrants a confirmatory test, not a claim of bias.
paragraphs.zh: 范围操控是明显可感知的：两个 LLM 听者与两位研究者都能在每一对中恢复出 Low–High 的排序。 然而智能体并不会因说话者范围受限而降低信任，且在修正后对投票或夜间行动均无显著影响。 信任估计被较窄的区间所约束（在 10 分量表上不超过 ± \pm 0.03 分），因此它们表明不存在具有实际意义的信任惩罚，而不仅仅是缺乏统计功效。 在投票上未经修正的模式——无论朝哪个方向偏离中性改述都会改变更多投票——与智能体对风格变化本身的反应一致，而非对受限范围的反应；这值得进行验证性检验，而不能作为存在偏差的论断。

These nulls rest on a valid manipulation; positive and bald rewrites were recognized by both researchers in 92–100% of cases.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在自然游玩中很少使用礼貌用语，这与其隐藏角色无关，而听众也不会将其视为关系信号：匹配或反转这种自然模式既不会改变投票，也不会改变信任。 这些零结果建立在有效的操纵之上；肯定式和直白式改写在92%到100%的情况下都能被两位研究人员识别出来。

Separating predicates from realizations makes language form an intervention, and re-sampled controls show how large the noise floor is: unchanged text already alters 14–16% of vote targets on replay, so comparisons without such a control would mistake model non-determinism for bias.

paragraphs.en: We introduced meaning-controlled counterfactual replays for testing whether the form of a message affects LLM agents’ social decisions, and applied them to linguistic range, a speaker-level trait, and politeness, an utterance-level strategy, in Werewolf. Neither manipulation shifts the trust other agents place in the speaker, and no effect on decisions survives correction for multiple comparisons. In natural play, agents speak mostly bluntly regardless of their role.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了意义受控的反事实重放方法，用于测试消息的形式是否会影响大语言模型智能体的社会决策，并将其应用于狼人杀中的两个维度：语言幅度（说话者层面的特质）与礼貌程度（话语层面的策略）。 两种操纵都不会改变其他智能体对说话者的信任，且没有任何效应在多重比较校正后仍然显著。 在自然对局中，智能体无论扮演何种角色，说话大多都直截了当。

paragraphs.en: All game agents use a single model, DeepSeek Flash, and judgments come from a small set of LLM judges; effects may differ for other model families and prompting setups. The experiments take place in one game with a fixed seven-player configuration. Our range manipulation changes only lexical and syntactic range, not the full construct of language proficiency. The range rewrites validated by humans and listeners come from a pilot with Qwen3.5-27B as the rewriter, whereas the replays use DeepSeek Flash; the in-game rewrites are checked automatically but have not been rated by humans. The researchers agreed poorly on whether politeness rewrites preserve meaning ( κ = 0.14 \kappa=0.14 ). Failed rewrites fall back to the original text, diluting treatment, especially for all_bald (11%). Replays estimate effects within a single day, and 30 games limit precision for small effects. The politeness judge has low off-record recall, and its natural-play labels have not been checked by hand.

paragraphs.en: This work studies LLM agents and involves no human game participants. The range manipulation varies properties of displayed text and makes no claims about any group’s speech, intelligence, or trustworthiness. Human annotations were produced by members of the research team on model-generated text containing no personal information. The two replay experiments cost about US$195 in API fees ($35 for range, $160 for politeness). Upon publication, we will release our code, prompts, generated game logs, and annotations for research use; the released dialogue is generated by LLM agents and contains no information about real people. We used an AI assistant (Claude) to check the paper grammar and to help write analysis scripts; the authors checked all results against the experiment data.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究探讨大语言模型智能体，不涉及任何人类游戏参与者。 范围操纵仅改变所显示文本的属性，不对任何群体的言语、智力或可信度作出任何断言。 人工标注由研究团队成员对不包含个人信息的模型生成文本进行标注。 两项重放实验的 API 费用约为 195 美元（范围实验 35 美元，礼貌实验 160 美元）。 论文发表后，我们将发布代码、提示词、生成的游戏日志及标注以供研究使用；所发布的对话由大语言模型智能体生成，不包含任何关于真实人物的信息。 我们使用 AI 助手（Claude）检查论文语法并协助编写分析脚本；作者将所有结果与实验数据进行了核对。

paragraphs.en: Every game has seven players: two werewolves, one seer, one guard, and three villagers. Werewolves know each other and choose one player to attack each night. The seer learns one player’s alignment ( wolf_camp or villager_camp ) each night. The guard protects one player from the attack each night, may protect themself, and cannot protect the same player on two consecutive nights. The game opens with Night 0, followed by a sheriff election among volunteers before Day 1; the sheriff sets the speaking order, speaks last, and casts 1.5 votes in the daytime vote, and passes the badge on or destroys it on leaving the game. In the daytime vote players may abstain; the player with the most votes is executed, a tie leads to a speech round between the tied players and a revote, and a second tie executes no one. Executed players give last words; night victims do not. Roles are revealed on death. paragraphs.en: The rewrites rated by humans and listeners ( Section 4.1 ) were generated by Qwen3.5-27B with a stricter gate of three checks. (1) A deterministic structural check: player IDs, predicate slots, and polarity are unchanged, no hedge is added, and please is neither added nor removed. (2) An inverse parser recovers the speech act from the rewrite alone, and its slots must match the recorded predicate. (3) A fidelity judge aligns every span of the two texts, marks each alignment as equivalent or not, and answers fixed questions on content, certainty, force, speaker perspective, references, politeness, and register; for Neutral it also rates vocabulary level, repetition, and syntax as simpler, same, or more advanced, and all three must be same . A failed candidate receives up to two corrective retries with the failure reasons. An utterance whose candidates all fail is marked unavailable, and a passage enters a comparison only when all of its utterances are available in both conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 由人工和收听者评定的改写（见4.1节）由Qwen3.5-27B生成，并采用包含三项检查的更严格门槛。 （1）确定性的结构检查：玩家ID、谓词槽和极性保持不变，不添加任何模糊限定词，且不添加或删除please。 （2）逆向解析器仅从改写中恢复言语行为，其槽位必须与记录的谓词匹配。 （3）忠实度评判者对两篇文本的每个片段进行对齐，将每个对齐标记为等价或不等价，并回答关于内容、确定性、语气力度、说话者视角、指称、礼貌程度和语域的固定问题；对于Neutral，它还将词汇水平、重复度和句法评为更简单、相同或更高级，且三项必须全部为相同。 未通过的候选会连同失败原因最多获得两次纠正性重试。 所有候选都失败的语句将被标记为不可用，且只有当一个段落在两种条件下所有语句都可用时，该段落才会进入比较。

paragraphs.en: Linguistic features are computed with spaCy and SUBTLEX-US. The primary measures are word frequency (SUBTLEX Lg10CD), vocabulary diversity (MATTR, 50-token window), and subordinate clauses per 100 words, with Benjamini–Hochberg correction within this family. MTLD, content-lemma repetition, dependency distance, parse-tree depth, noun-phrase length, and sentence length are secondary. Grammar is checked with LanguageTool errors per 100 words and CoLA acceptability. Effects average players within each game and weight games equally; intervals resample games. With three games, the smallest attainable two-sided p p is .25, so the pilot reports estimates and intervals only.
paragraphs.zh: 语言特征使用 spaCy 和 SUBTLEX-US 计算。 主要指标包括词频（SUBTLEX Lg10CD）、词汇多样性（MATTR，50 词窗口）以及每 100 词中的从句数量，并在该指标族内进行 Benjamini–Hochberg 校正。 MTLD、实词词元重复率、依存距离、句法树深度、名词短语长度和句子长度为次要指标。 语法通过 LanguageTool 每 100 词错误数和 CoLA 可接受度进行检验。 效应值对每局游戏内的玩家取平均，并对各局游戏等权处理；区间通过对游戏进行重抽样获得。 由于只有三局游戏，双侧 p 值最小可达到 .25，因此试验性研究仅报告估计值和区间。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.5-27B and GPT Luna 5.6 read two passages by the same player in both presentation orders. The range question asks which passage shows the more limited range of English, or same ; a second, proficiency question asks which speaker seems to have the weaker command of English. Answers are scored + 1 +1 (treatment judged more limited), 0 (same), or − 1 -1 and averaged over orders, listeners, and passages within a game. On the range question, both listeners judge Low more limited than Neutral and High, and High less limited than Neutral, in every passage and both orders (Qwen answers same in 2 of 30 Low–Neutral comparisons). On Neutral versus Natural, Qwen answers same in 97% of pairs (signed preference − 0.02 -0.02 ); GPT Luna answers same in 63% and otherwise calls Natural more limited ( − 0.30 -0.30 [ − 0.57 -0.57 , − 0.14 -0.14 ]). On the proficiency question, Qwen calls most pairs the same (70% of Low–Neutral, 75% of High–Neutral) and otherwise picks the expected side (Low–Neutral + 0.30 +0.30 , Low–High + 0.71 +0.71 ); GPT Luna picks the expected side on High–Neutral ( − 0.62 -0.62 ) but gives the same answer in both orders for 7 of 15 Low–Neutral passages ( + 0.00 +0.00 ). Range differences are therefore perceptible, while their reading as weaker proficiency is less consistent.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.5-27B 和 GPT Luna 5.6 以两种呈现顺序阅读同一玩家的两段文字。 语言范围问题询问哪一段文字表现出更有限的英语使用范围，或相同；第二个熟练度问题则询问哪位说话者看起来对英语的掌握较弱。 答案计分为 +1（判定实验组更有限）、0（相同）或 −1，并在每个对局内对顺序、听者和段落取平均。 在语言范围问题上，在所有段落和两种顺序中，两位听者都判定 Low 比 Neutral 和 High 更有限，而 High 比 Neutral 更不有限（Qwen 在 30 次 Low–Neutral 比较中有 2 次回答相同）。 在 Neutral 与 Natural 的比较中，Qwen 在 97% 的配对中回答相同（符号化偏好 −0.02）；GPT Luna 在 63% 的配对中回答相同，其余情况下判定 Natural 更有限（−0.30 [−0.57, −0.14]）。 在熟练度问题上，Qwen 将大多数配对判定为相同（Low–Neutral 为 70%，High–Neutral 为 75%），其余情况下选择预期的一方（Low–Neutral 为 +0.30，Low–High 为 +0.71）；GPT Luna 在 High–Neutral 上选择预期的一方（−0.62），但在 15 段 Low–Neutral 文字中有 7 段在两种顺序下给出相同答案（+0.00）。 因此，语言范围差异是可感知的，而将其解读为较弱的熟练度则不那么一致。

paragraphs.en: The 13 source utterances come from 11 untreated seven-player games and realize estimate (3), question (3), recommend_action (4), disagree (1), address_role (1), and unallied (1). DeepSeek Flash rewrote each into all four strategies at temperature 0, using one prompt per strategy written from Brown and Levinson’s definitions ( Appendix C ). All prompts forbid changing the speaker, target, polarity, or reasons. Positive politeness may add rapport but not invented praise or evidence; negative politeness softens the act, not the truth claim; off-record keeps the target and proposition recoverable.

paragraphs.en: The researchers chose the same strategy on 43 of 52 items (83%, κ = 0.77 \kappa=0.77 ). Four disagreements involve off-record items that Researcher 1 read as a bald, positive, or negative act, four are between positive and negative politeness, and one item was labeled ambiguous . On meaning, Researcher 1 answered yes on 46 items and Researcher 2 on 37; neither used unsure . paragraphs.en: The politeness judge is GPT Luna 5.6, run three times per item with the majority label kept. It sees only the utterance, the speaker, and the phase, and is never told the requested strategy. It first names the speech act in at most 12 words and then decides how that act is realized: stated directly (bald on-record), stated through solidarity or common ground (positive), stated but softened through deference or reduced imposition (negative), or left for the listener to infer (off-record). The prompt instructs it not to label from politeness markers alone: openers such as “Interesting that …”, tag questions, and hedges do not make a stated act off-record. Two further labels, ambiguous_or_mixed and failed_manipulation , cover utterances with no dominant strategy and unusable text. The judge matches Researcher 1 on 42 of 52 items ( κ = 0.74 \kappa=0.74 ) and Researcher 2 on 43 ( κ = 0.77 \kappa=0.77 ). Table 12 gives its confusion matrices.

Two-sided p p -values come from a sign-flip test that flips each seed’s mean difference (5,000 permutations). Holm correction is applied across all contrasts and measures in a table. Human-validation proportions use exact binomial intervals.
